about: Request-layer mapping vectors for H-29 (phase 2). One or more vectors per request row of dev/surfaces/policy.manifest (ws/rest/companion; cmd rows are proven at the command layer), plus negative vectors. Authored from the contract only. A request goes in; the row it matches, its disposition (write, read-deferred, exempt, unmapped, unmappable) and, for a write, its (resource, verb) set come out. Checks compare as a set. `refused` is the phase-2 consequence (D-74): unmappable is refused; unmapped is refused for every WS type and every non-GET method. `facts` is what the same command invocation already holds (D-72), overlaid on `facts_ref`.
